_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score and F&G sit mid-Panic band with flat 30d price, no sub-24h catalyst, and coil base rate 3% for ±2 moves; HOLD is the graded call until a band exit.
next_move.brains_agree: yes on current Panic phase; narrative has no separate forward call so analyst HOLD/Panic carries
next_move.confirmed_if: Cycle score and fear_greed stay inside 24-31 and BTC holds a sub-1.5% range over next 12h
next_move.invalidated_if: Score leaves Panic by 2+ points (below 23 Capitulation or above 32 Denial) on a directional BTC break
